==Biography==
Nappon was born in Três Passos, Rio Grande do Sul, but moved to Goiás with his friends to attend college.

== Trivia ==
* His nickname Nappon stands for Napão, which means "big nose" in Portuguese.
* He has lived in almost all corners of Brazil: Rio Grande do Sul (south), Bahia (northeast), Goiás (central) and São Paulo (southeast).
* Considered by many [[CNB e-Sports Club]] fans as the most skilled player from new line up.
* Portrayed as {{ci|Lee Sin}} in the CBLoL 2015 official wallpaper.
